_LYRIC_PERSISTENCE_DESCRIPTION: Automatically matched lyrics are saved on this device. A manual selection replaces the automatic match, and DeepSeek translations are not evicted by song count.
_AUDIO_CACHE_DESCRIPTION: The first play caches complete audio in the background. Temporary audio outside My Playlists is removed on quit, while playlist cache and explicit downloads remain.
_LOUDNESS_NORMALIZATION_DESCRIPTION: Analyzed tracks are adjusted during playback. First plays or tracks that have not been analyzed keep their original volume; original files are never changed.
_LOUDNESS_NORMALIZATION_STATUS: Analyzed {{ready}} tracks · Analyzing {{pending}} tracks · {{failed}} could not be analyzed safely (original volume kept)
_AUDIO_CACHE_FAILURE_NOTICE: A cache download failure does not affect normal playback.
_AUDIO_CACHE_CLEAR_CONFIRM_DESCRIPTION: This deletes only audio files cached on this device. Lyrics, translations, and playback settings are kept.
_AUDIO_CACHE_SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Search title, artist, or Bilibili ID
_AUDIO_CACHE_ONLY_TEMPORARY: Only temporary cache removed on quit
_AUDIO_CACHE_DELETE_AUDIO_ONLY: Only cached audio and loudness analysis will be removed. Playlists, lyrics, and translations stay intact.
_AUDIO_CACHE_INVENTORY_EMPTY: No cached songs match these filters.
_AUDIO_CACHE_DOWNLOAD_ADDED: Added to the offline download queue
_AUDIO_CACHE_DELETE_TRACK_CONFIRM_TITLE: Delete all local data for this song?
_AUDIO_CACHE_DELETE_TRACK_CONFIRM_DESCRI: This deletes this song's cached audio, lyrics, translations, and lyric offset on this device. Playlists and cloud music are not changed.

_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_DESCRIPTION: DeepSeek is used only after you confirm a full-lyric translation or choose AI retranslation. Existing translations are shown by default and never trigger a new AI request automatically.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_RETRANSLATE_CONFIRM: Retranslate the full lyric with DeepSeek?
This bypasses the current cache and sends the title, artist, and complete lyric to DeepSeek for a new translation. API charges may apply.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_PRIVACY_NOTICE: Only the title, artist, timed lyric, and this style preference are sent. Your API key and local listening history are never sent.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_VIEW_PROMPT: View fixed rules and this prompt
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_PROMPT_TEMPLATE: This request's prompt preview (no real lyrics)
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_STYLE_HINT_PLACEHOL: For example: restrained and natural; preserve the imagery and rhythm
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_STYLE_HINT_HELP: Leave blank for the default style. Up to 1200 characters; fixed rules and model cannot be edited.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_STYLE_DEFAULT: Modern, natural, accurate Simplified Chinese with restrained poetic tone; preserve imagery, emotion, and resonance.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_RESTORE_SOURCE_SESS: Show the source translation for this session only; the cached preference is unchanged
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_SOURCE_RESTORED: The source translation is shown for this session; the cached preference was not changed.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_KEY_SAVED: An API key is securely stored
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_TEST_NOTICE: Testing the connection may use a small number of tokens.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_SECURE_STORAGE_NOTI: Your key is stored with this device's secure storage when available.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_KEY_CLEARED: The DeepSeek API key was removed.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_MISSING_KEY: Enter and save a DeepSeek API key before translating.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_INVALID_KEY: The DeepSeek API key is invalid.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_SECURE_STORAGE_UNAV: Secure API key storage is unavailable on this system.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_ACCOUNT_LIMIT: DeepSeek could not process the request because of an account or billing limit. Check your API account and try again.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_RATE_LIMITED: DeepSeek is busy. Try again shortly.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_ALIGNMENT_FAILED: The translated line mapping was incomplete, so the result was discarded.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_SAME_LANGUAGE: The lyric is already in the target language.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_NOT_CACHED: No saved DeepSeek translation is available for this lyric yet.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_FAILED: DeepSeek translation is temporarily unavailable. Check your network and API key, then try again.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_INVALID_RESPONSE: DeepSeek returned an incomplete translation, so it was not applied. Please try again.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_INVALID_REQUEST: DeepSeek rejected this translation request. Check your API key and try again.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_INVALID_STYLE_HINT: The translation style preference is invalid. Remove control characters or shorten it and try again.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_UNSUPPORTED_TARGET_: DeepSeek lyric translation currently supports Simplified Chinese only.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: DeepSeek is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.

_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_CONFIRM_DESCRIPTION: The song title, artist, and complete lyric will be sent to DeepSeek. This may create API charges.
_MACHINE_TRANSLATION_CONFIRM_ACTION: Use DeepSeek to translate the full lyric
